info.name: OPDS+
info.summary: Serve a folder of e-books as an OPDS catalog for e-reader apps
info.description:
Turns a folder in your Nextcloud into an OPDS 1.2 catalog that e-reader apps (KOReader, Moon+ Reader, Thorium, Librera, Aldiko, Foliate, ...) can browse, sort and download from.
* Metadata is read from EPUB, PDF, CBZ (ComicInfo.xml), MOBI/AZW/AZW3, FB2 and DOCX files, with a filename fallback ("Author - Title.ext"). * Browse by author, title, series, genre/subject, publisher, language, publication year, format or folder, search, and sort every list by title, author, publication date, date added, date modified, publisher, series, language, format or file size. * Covers are extracted from the books and served as OPDS images/thumbnails. * Browse the same library inside Nextcloud: covers, search, authors, series, genres and downloads. * Beta, off by default: edit the metadata and covers of Calibre libraries. * With the News app installed, a News entry offers the latest articles of all or selected feeds and folders as an EPUB: one part per feed, one chapter per article. * Log in from your reader with your Nextcloud user name and an app password (Settings > Security > Devices & sessions).
info.author: fifthQuark
